chunks: ʿAlī ibn Muḥammad, from Sahl ibn Ziyād, from Muḥammad ibn al-Walīd, from Yūnus ibn Yaʿqūb, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, that he heard him saying:
Allah refused to make it for two brothers after al-Ḥasan and al-Ḥusayn عليهما السلام.

key_terms.أَبَى: refused or willed not to permit
key_terms.اللَّهُ: Allah, the One who decrees and appoints
key_terms.يَجْعَلَهَا: to make it or appoint it, referring here to the Imamate

ai.seo_question: Did Allah appoint the Imamate to two brothers after Imam al-Ḥasan and Imam al-Ḥusayn عليهما السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith states that the Imamate was not made to continue in two brothers after Imam al-Ḥasan and Imam al-Ḥusayn عليهما السلام. It indicates a specific divinely ordained pattern for the continuation of the Imamate within the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام.
